</font>[mspaint]
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Addons now support GameIds in the supported games list</font>

[DOORS]

<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Fixed Auto Hide not disabling itself properly with the keybind</font>

[DOORS - Super Hard Mode]
<font color="rgb(255,0,0)">Removed Figure Godmode</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Fixed random errors</font>

[DOORS - The Archives, The Stairwell, The Candy Vault]
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Improved restoration and disabling of Anticheat Bypass</font>

[DOORS - The Stairwell, The Candy Vault]
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Improved Disable Creak FE</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Fixed Anticheat Bypass and Disable Creak FE order and other issues with these features</font>

[DOORS - The Candy Vault]
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added Auto Crack Vault</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added Show Vault Combination</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added Vault Timer Warning</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added breakable fence doors to Auto Interact</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added Candy Scrap Items to Auto Interact Ignore List</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added Candy Vault and Jewerly Key ESP</font>
<font color="rgb(0,255,0)">Added Cauldron to Objective ESP</font>
